The '''Alsakan Overlook''' was the name given to the outcropping on the south side of [[Mount Tessef]], a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. From the Overlook, one could see the river that bordered the [[Alsakan Lowlands]] to the west, and the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]]-infested southern valley of [[King's Pass]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Alsakan Overlook appears as a location on Alderaan in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
